notion.how: live/notion.js: a paste event on an empty text block, read back from Notion's blocks
observed: text | Intro with bold, italic, both and a link. [bold:bold] [italic:italic] [bold+italic:both] [link:link]
to_do [ ] | Task in a mixed list
notes: To-dos need <input type="checkbox"> as the item's first content. A ☐ character or a box image inside the item stays in the to-do (images become image blocks).
Notion builds blocks only when text/plain has the same lines; a one-line text/plain makes it paste everything as inline text.
Dewi's own cmd+V of a real Airtable checklist through the Docs output also gave real to-dos (3 Oct 2026).

airtable.how: live/quill.js in a rich text field: the field's own Quill 1 clipboard, then saved and read back through the API
observed: unchecked | Task in a mixed list
notes: Real checklists come only from <ul data-checked>; checkbox inputs, images and ☐ characters become plain bullets.
Nesting comes only from class="ql-indent-N" on items whose nested list sits beside, not inside, the parent item; a list inside a nested item lands one level too shallow.

google-docs.how: live/google-docs.js, read back with the Docs API and by eye
observed: square bullet | Task in a mixed list
notes: Google Docs makes native checklists only from its own private clipboard data. Tried and failed: <input type="checkbox">, role="checkbox" aria-checked (with and without the docs-internal-guid wrapper and Docs' own tick-box image), list-style-type strings, and Docs' private data written by another source.
So tasks get square bullets, the one marker Docs honours. A ticked item looks like an unticked one.

slack.how: live/quill.js in the message box (no recipient): Slack's own Quill clipboard, nothing inserted
notes: Slack ignores list-style-type, so a task item inside a list keeps its bullet: tasks are written as lines instead.
A list nested inside an item merges the items into one line ("OneOne AOne A i").

gmail.how: a paste event in a new message's body (left as a draft), read back from the compose DOM
notes: Gmail swaps ☑ for a coloured emoji image even with U+FE0E; ☒ stays text.
Lists nested inside items get uneven spacing in Gmail (gaps of 21, 29, 21 and 46px); nested lists beside their parent item get an even 29px at every level.
